messages.content: 软件加密采用哪些技术或算法来加密语音和数据业务？
软件加密采用海能达自有（Hytera加密）或DMR标准（DMRA加密）的技术/算法。
DMR终端和PDT终端在支持的软件加密类型上有什么区别？
DMR终端支持Hytera加密和DMRA加密，而PDT终端仅支持Hytera加密。
什么是硬件加密，其密钥和算法如何存储？
硬件加密是指密钥和加密算法均由客户提供并保存在专用的加密卡中，终端使用加密卡中的密钥和算法进行端到端加密。
哪种终端支持硬件加密？
仅PDT终端支持硬件加密。
软件加密采用哪些技术或算法对语音和数据业务进行加密？
软件加密采用海能达自有（Hytera加密）或DMR标准（DMRA加密）的技术/算法。
相比硬件加密，软件加密的主要优势是什么？
降低了硬件加密带来的成本。
DMR终端支持哪种加密方式？
DMR终端仅支持DMRA加密。
PDT终端支持哪种加密方式？
PDT终端仅支持Hytera加密。
什么是硬件加密，PDT硬件加密功能遵循什么标准？
硬件加密是指密钥和加密算法均由客户提供并保存在专用的加密卡中，终端使用加密卡中的密钥和算法进行端到端加密。PDT硬件加密功能采用中国公安部的专用加密芯片，加密协议遵照PDT安全标准执行。
在TMO和DMO模式下使用端到端加密功能的前提条件是什么？
需要通过Smart MDM进行授权。授权后，在TMO和DMO模式下均可使用该功能。
如何完成端到端加密密钥的配置及导入？
通过Smart MDM和KMS一并完成端到端加密密钥的配置及导入。
终端在TMO模式和DMO模式下的端到端加密密钥是否相同？
是相同的。终端在TMO模式和DMO模式下共用同一份密钥。
在哪些模式下可以使用端到端加密功能？
授权后，在TMO和DMO模式下均可使用端到端加密功能。
终端在TMO模式和DMO模式下的密钥是否相同？
终端在TMO模式和DMO模式下共用同一份密钥。
在组织终端管理权限方面，系统支持哪种限制设置？
支持设置当前组织只能管理本组织的终端，不可管理子组织的终端。
如果通过非 Smart MDM 渠道修改了执法记录仪密码，导致连接工作站时验证失败，应如何处理？
需在工作站输入修改后的执法记录仪密码。
What warning message appears when running ./synchron_sql.sh regarding password usage?
mysql: [Warning] Using a password on the command line interface can be insecure. mysqldump: [Warning] Using a password on the command line interface can be insecure.
E机型在使用数据透传功能时，若开启了文本消息加密，对分组数据类型有何要求？
若终端开启了文本消息加密，分组数据只能选择专用型分组数据，否则发送失败；E机型数据透传不支持加密的共享分组数据。
What is the primary function of the Key Management System (KMS)?
The Key Management System (KMS) is an encryption key management system for multi-mode advanced radios and narrowband radios, which can independently complete the production and distribution of keys.
Which menu items are available on the KMS homepage for an administrator?
The administrator homepage includes the following menu items: KMS, Devices, Keys, Files, Tasks, Distribution, Account, and Log.
What happens if KMS remains idle for more than 10 minutes?
KMS will automatically log out.
Which operations can an Administrator perform under the Device configuration option?
An Administrator can import the radio file (.zip) including information of radio, delete keys of radio, and write service password of radio.
Under what conditions must the same password be set for the corresponding radio in KMS, and what happens if this is not done?

You must set the same password in KMS when the service password has been set for the multi-mode advanced radio by Smart MDM or the programming password has been set for the narrowband radio by CPS. Otherwise, the key pack cannot be distributed.
Which keys need to be added when the E2EE Type is set to TETRA E2EE for Teltronic encryption?
For Teltronic encryption with E2EE Type set to TETRA E2EE, you need to add the KEK and TEK keys.
What are the supported encryption algorithms for configuring encryption key information?
AES-128 and AES-256 algorithms.
How do you export a key pack intended for KMS usage?
To export a key pack for KMS, select the radios, input the password of the key file, and click Export.
What is the procedure for importing a key pack?
To import a key pack, click Browse and select the key file, input the password of the key file, and then click Import.
What are the requirements and source of the E_Key file used for creating trunking authentication keys?
The E_Key file is in .pdt or .dmr format and is used to create trunking authentication keys. This file and its corresponding password are provided by the DMR/PDT system.
What are the configuration steps for adding a Conventional Authentication Key in DMR?
Enter the key name, set Type as DMR, set Key Type as K, set Working Mode as Conventional/XPT, and then click OK. After that, configure the key length and key value.
What is the recommended security action after the first login to KMS?
It is suggested to change password after first login.
What security mechanisms are built into the PTC760 to safeguard communications?

Signature authentication and preconfigured Se Android security strategy are utilized to ensure system security. All static user data is full-disk encrypted, while E2EE and AIE are used to secure data transmission.
申请与License匹配的加密狗时，需要向技术人员提供哪些设备数量信息？
需要提供多模终端、宽带终端与执法记录仪、窄带设备的数量。
PUK 码输入超过次数限制会导致什么后果？
SIM 卡将作废。
术语 E2EE 的英文全称和中文全称分别是什么？
E2EE 的英文全称是 End-to-End Encryption，中文全称是端到端加密。
若通过管理端之外的渠道修改了执法记录仪密码，导致连接工作站时验证失败，应如何解决？
需在工作站输入修改后的执法记录仪密码。
如何更改主屏的锁屏样式？
点击“设置”，在“安全”中选择“屏幕锁定”，将锁屏样式设置为滑动、图案或密码。
对讲机被调度台或系统遥晕与遥毙有什么区别？
遥晕时，对讲机不能响应任何菜单或按键操作、也不能发起或接收任何网络服务，但保留了登记、复活、鉴权、开关机及锁屏等功能，收到复活指令后可恢复正常。遥毙时，对讲机失去除开关机外的所有功能，需返回厂家处理才能重新使用。
什么是倒放功能，以及如何开启或关闭它？
倒放是指当对讲机倾斜角度大于预设角度或保持相对静止（或匀速运动）超过预设时间后，自动进入紧急报警模式。移动或扶正对讲机可退出预警提示。开启或关闭方式包括：点击“对讲设置”，选择“告警安全 > 倒放”进行开关设置，或按【倒放】快捷键。
How should the Micro SIM card be placed on the tray?
Place the Micro SIM card with the gold contacts facing up on the tray.
EDACS支持哪些通信模式？
EDACS支持数字语音、数字数据、数字化语音加密和用于互相帮助用的模拟FM。
Smart MDM V4.5.10.000 版本在超级管理员权限管理上相比早期版本有什么变化？
早期版本只支持一个超级管理员，V4.5.10.000 版本开始支持多个超级管理员，便于各组织管理资产和事物，同时便于记录各个超级管理员的操作记录。
通过 Smart MDM 之外的渠道修改执法记录仪密码后，导致连接时密码验证失败，应如何处理？
需在工作站输入修改后的执法记录仪密码。
广播全呼与非广播全呼在语音发射权限上有什么区别？
广播全呼过程中，仅主叫可以发射语音，被叫只能接收语音；非广播全呼过程中，主叫和被叫都可以发射语音。
如何设置 WLAN 热点的名称、安全性及密码？
点击“设置”，在“网络和互联网”中选择“热点和网络共享 > WLAN 热点”，开启 WLAN 热点后，设置 WLAN 热点名称、安全性及热点密码。
对讲机被遥晕后保留哪些功能？如何使其恢复正常使用？
被遥晕的对讲机保留了登记、复活、鉴权、开关机及锁屏等功能，但无法响应其他菜单或按键操作，也不能发起或接收网络服务。收到调度台或系统的复活指令后，可以恢复正常使用。
如何设置应用程序的自启动和网络权限？
点击应用程序自启动开关可关闭或开启自启动功能；点击“移动数据”或“WLAN”网络权限开关可关闭或开启该应用程序对应的网络权限。
E2EE 的全称和中文含义是什么？
E2EE 的全称是 End-to-End Encryption，中文含义是端到端加密。
What happens if an incorrect PUK number is entered more than the maximum allowed times?
The SIM card becomes invalid.
What does the abbreviation E2EE stand for?
End-to-End Encryption
KMC工具主要管理哪几类密钥？
KMC可管理的密钥包括鉴权密钥（K）、静态空口加密密钥（SCK）和端到端加密密钥（E2EE）。
KMC与SMART MDM配合完成终端密钥创建及写入的具体流程是什么？
首先通过KMC创建密钥；其次使用密钥、终端信息文件和SMART MDM导出的密钥申请单一并生成密钥文件包；最后将该包发送给SMART MDM，由SMART MDM完成对终端密钥的写入。
K、SCK 和 E2EE 分别用于添加什么类型的密钥？
K 用于添加鉴权密钥，SCK 用于添加静态空口加密密钥，E2EE 用于添加端到端加密密钥。
如何新建和导入 .kmc 密钥文件？
新建是使用 K、SCK 或 E2EE 密钥创建 .kmc 密钥文件；导入是将 .kmc 密钥文件导入 KMC。
在生成密钥文件包的过程中，.kmc 格式密钥文件的作用是什么？其安全性如何保障？
.kmc 格式密钥文件是使用添加的密钥创建的，用于后续生成密钥文件包。该文件以密文形式保存，打开后无法查看密钥信息，从而保证密钥的安全传输。
DMR/PDT 终端与 TETRA 终端在添加密钥时分别需要添加哪些类型的密钥？
DMR/PDT 终端需添加鉴权密钥和端到端加密密钥；TETRA 终端需添加鉴权密钥、静态空口加密密钥和端到端加密密钥。
TEI-K 文件和 E_Key 文件的格式、来源及适用场景分别是什么？
TEI-K 是 .txt 格式文件，由系统侧提供，仅用于 TETRA 终端新建 TEI-K 鉴权密钥。E_Key 是 .pdt 或 .dmr 格式文件，由系统侧提供（含对应密码），仅用于 DMR/PDT 终端新建集群鉴权密钥。
生成最终 .key 格式密钥文件包需要哪些输入文件？终端信息文件在其中起什么作用？
生成 .key 格式密钥文件包需要使用密钥申请单和密钥文件。终端信息文件用于导入终端信息，在生成密钥文件包时需校验终端信息。
如何新建集群并配置鉴权密钥？
首先单击“K”显示鉴权密钥配置界面，然后单击“新建集群”，在弹出的“文件名”窗口中输入文件名称后单击“确定”，最后在弹出的窗口中导入 E_Key 文件并输入对应的密码。
What is the password range for E_Key?
What is the password range for H_Key?
如何进入端到端加密密钥配置界面？
单击“E2EE”。
在密钥配置过程中，如何设置密钥名称？
单击“新建”，在弹出的“文件名”窗口中输入密钥名称后单击“确定”。
端到端加密密钥长度（Length）支持哪几种比特数？
支持 40 比特、128 比特和 256 比特三种长度的密钥。
在创建密钥文件时，Value 值是如何生成的，是否支持修改？
创建密钥文件时已自动生成 30 个 Value 值，可手动更改 Value 值。
如何新建 TEI-K 并设置密钥名称？
单击“新建 TEI-K”，在弹出的“文件名”窗口中输入密钥名称后单击“确定”。
鉴权密钥K的格式要求是什么？
K为32位16进制字符串。
如何新建一个K-Only密钥并命名？
单击“新建 K-Only”，在弹出的“文件名”窗口中输入密钥名称后单击“确定”。
如何进入静态空口加密密钥配置界面？
单击“SCK”即可显示静态空口加密密钥配置界面。
在静态空口加密密钥配置中，如何输入版本号和密钥值？
在“Version”中输入静态密钥版本号，并在“Value”中输入静态密钥。
如果已有 SCK 密钥文件，应如何操作？
可以单击“导入”直接导入密钥。
端到端加密密钥支持哪两种长度？
支持 128 比特和 256 比特两种长度的密钥。
如何生成端到端加密密钥的 Value 值？
单击“新建”可自动生成 Value 值，也可手动输入该值。
如何开始导入密钥文件的操作？
单击“导入”，显示导入密钥文件界面。
在导入密钥文件过程中，单击“保存”后会发生什么？
弹出“另存为”窗口。
在“另存为”窗口中需要执行哪些操作来配置密钥文件？
选择密钥文件的保存路径并输入文件名。
完成密钥文件配置的最后一步操作是什么？
单击“保存”。
如何生成密钥文件包？
1. 单击“生成密钥”，弹出“打开”窗口。 2. 在“打开”窗口中选择密钥申请单，单击“打开”。 3. 在弹出的“另存为”窗口中选择密钥文件包在本地的保存路径，并输入文件名。 4. 单击“保存”完成密钥文件包的制作。
如何导入.kmc格式的密钥文件？
在“打开”窗口中选择要导入.kmc格式的密钥文件，单击“打开”完成导入。
在哪里可以删除KMC上的密钥信息？
在密钥配置界面，可以删除KMC上的密钥信息。
在创建密钥文件界面，如何删除 KMC 上的密钥文件？
选中需要删除的密钥文件并单击“删除”，则该密钥文件被删除。
E2EE 代表什么技术？
E2EE 代表 End-to-End Encryption，即端到端加密。
在增加管理员之前需要执行什么操作以确定其权限？
需要指定角色。
What actions does enabling PTT Authorization (PDT) require from the user during a call?
When enabled, the user needs authorization from the PDT system to talk by PTT during a call.
Smart MDM 的 admin 用户具有什么权限？
admin 是 Smart MDM 管理端缺省管理员，具有最高权限。
如何向海能达申请硬加密狗的 License？需要提供哪些资料？
需要向海能达提供加密狗侧边 ID、Key ID 和 *.c2v 文件。
在 Smart MDM 服务运行期间，对加密狗有什么操作限制？
请勿拔出加密狗。
在 Smart MDM 服务运行期间，如果使用了硬件加密狗，有什么操作禁忌？
请勿拔出加密狗。
在工作站环境中，加密狗由谁提供且是否必需？
工作站需要加密狗，该设备由海能达提供。
忘记 admin 账号的登录密码时应如何处理？
联系 Hytera 客服。
本产品的防爆合格证书编号和防爆标志分别是什么？
防爆合格证书编号为 CMExC23.4477X，防爆标志为 Exib IIIB T4 Gb 和 Exib IIICT130°C Db。
当产品的安全性或完整性受到危及时，应采取哪些紧急措施？
应立即停止本产品的任何操作并离开爆炸区域，避免再次使用，并将产品送往制造商进行检查。
自行拆卸或改装经过防爆检测机构认证的产品会有什么后果？谁有权进行改装？
未经授权的改装将导致该产品防爆认证失效。只有产品的原制造商才可在经过防爆检测机构许可的范围内进行改装。
What does the NOTE icon indicate in the KMS Operation Guide?
The NOTE icon indicates references that can further describe the related topics.
What is the function of the '>' symbol in the KMS Operation Guide instructions?
The '>' symbol directs you to access a multi-level menu.
What are the primary functions and supported radio types of the Key Management System (KMS)?
The Key Management System (KMS) is an encryption key management system for multi-mode advanced radios and narrowband radios. It can independently complete the production and distribution of keys.
Which menu options are available on the KMS homepage for an administrator?
The administrator's KMS homepage includes the following options: KMS, Devices, Keys, Files, Tasks, Distribution, Account, and Log.
What functions are associated with the 'Device' and 'Tasks' configuration options in KMS?
The 'Device' option allows importing radio files (.zip) containing radio information, deleting radio keys, and writing service passwords. The 'Tasks' option allows terminating or redoing tasks.
Which keys need to be added when the E2EE Type is set to TETRA E2EE using OTAK (T) for Teltronic encryption?
When using OTAK (T) for Teltronic encryption with E2EE Type set to TETRA E2EE, you need to add the KEK and TEK keys.
Which encryption algorithms are supported by KMMEA?
KMMEA supports AES-128 and AES-256.
What are the steps to export a key pack for KMS?
To export a key pack for KMS, select the radios, enter the password of the key file, and then click Export.
What are the configuration steps for adding a Conventional Authentication Key with Type DMR and Key Type K?
Enter the key name, set Type as DMR, set Key Type as K, set Working Mode as Conventional/XPT, click OK, and then configure the key length and key value.
How is the hexadecimal authentication key value generated or modified during configuration?
The key is automatically generated when the key file is created. You can manually modify the value or click to regenerate the value.
How do you configure an authentication key for Conventional work mode?
Enter the key name, set Type as PDT, set Key Type as K, set Working Mode as Conventional, and then click OK.
How can a user change their password after logging into the KMS?
Click the down arrow and select Change Password, then enter the old and new passwords and click OK.
Where can the trial certificate files HyteraMDMkey and mdm.cer be obtained for configuring HTTPS?
The trial certificate files HyteraMDMkey and mdm.cer can be obtained in the folder Certificate(Trial) of the installation disk.
What are the required filenames for the private key and public key certificates after obtaining them from a CA?
The private key file must be changed to HyteraMDMkey, and the public key file must be changed to mdm.cer.
NFC技术的主要特点有哪些？
NFC是一种提供轻松、安全、快速通信的无线连接技术。
E2EE（端到端加密）的主要作用是什么？
E2EE是对对讲机的语音或数据进行端到端加密，为语音或数据提供可靠的安全保护，可以有效防止被偷听或被窃取。
对讲机被遥晕后有哪些功能限制和保留功能？如何恢复？
被遥晕时，对讲机主屏和顶屏显示图标，不能响应任何菜单或按键操作，也不能发起或接收任何网络服务（包括呼叫和短消息）。但保留了登记、复活、鉴权、开关机及锁屏等功能。收到调度台或系统的复活指令后，可以恢复正常使用。
若需管理特定应用访问位置信息的权限，应如何操作？
在应用详情界面选择“权限 > 位置信息”，然后设置该应用程序是否开启访问位置信息的权限。
PUK 码输入超过次数限制会有什么后果？
SIM 卡将作废。
如何为特定应用设置密码以防止未经许可的使用？
点击“设置”，点击“应用锁”，根据界面提示设置应用锁密码并选择需要加锁的应用。
What is the consequence of changing the RVM password without using Admin Client, and how should it be resolved?
Changing the RVM password not through Admin Client will lead to verification failure between RVM and User Client. To resolve this, you need to input the new password on User Client.
What is the purpose of the Common Cipher Key (CCK) generated by the infrastructure?
The Common Cipher Key (CCK) is used to protect group addressed signalling and traffic. It is also used for the protection of SSI identities (ESI) in layer 2.
What is the Extended Common Cipher Key (CCKX) and what is its primary function?

The Extended Common Cipher Key (CCKX) is a cipher key generated by the infrastructure to protect group addressed signalling and traffic where an air interface encryption algorithm from TEA set B is in use. It can also be used to protect SSI identities (ESI or MAE) in layer 2.
How is the Extended Modified Group Cipher Key (MGCKX) composed and what does it protect?

The Extended Modified Group Cipher Key (MGCKX) is a cipher key known by the infrastructure and MS to protect group addressed signalling and traffic. It is composed algorithmically from CCKX and GCKX where an air interface encryption algorithm from TEA set B is in use.
Under what conditions may the Extended Static Cipher Key (SCKX) be used?

The Extended Static Cipher Key (SCKX) is a predetermined cipher key that may be used to provide confidentiality in class 2 systems with a corresponding algorithm. It may also be used in DMO or for fallback where an air interface encryption algorithm from TEA set B is in use.
How is the Group Cipher Key (GCK) used at the air interface?
The GCK is not used directly at the air interface; it is modified by the CCK to produce a modified group cipher key (MGCK).
How is the Modified Group Cipher Key (MGCK) composed and what is its purpose?
The Modified Group Cipher Key (MGCK) is a cipher key known by the infrastructure and MS, composed algorithmically from CCK and GCK. Its purpose is to protect group addressed signalling and traffic.
Which security capabilities can an MS optionally indicate during registration?
The MS can indicate the ability to support DCK air interface encryption, SCK air interface encryption, authentication and/or end-to-end encryption.
Which three techniques are used in designing TETRA high-speed QAM channels to increase their range compared to the reference π/4-DQPSK channel?

The three techniques are: 1) introduction of multiple sub-carriers per channel (8 per 25 kHz), 2) coherent detection, and 3) Parallel Concatenated Convolutional Coding (PCCC), which is a type of turbo-coding.
What are the two types of security supported by TETRA?
TETRA supports air interface security and end-to-end security.
What specific elements does air interface security protect on the link between the MS and the BS?
Air interface security protects the user's identity, signalling, speech, and data (including circuit mode data, SDSS, and packet data).
Does air interface security provide protection for internal links inside the SwMI or connections outside the SwMI?
No, it does not provide protection on internal links inside the SwMI or connections outside the SwMI, such as to the PSTN.
What is the intended security level of the TETRA radio interface provided by air interface security?

What is the relationship between end-to-end encryption and air-interface security in terms of operation and recommended usage?

End-to-end encryption operates independently of air-interface security. However, for maximum user protection, air interface security should be applied on top of end-to-end security to protect user identities and signalling messages.
Which types of data and communications can be protected by end-to-end encryption?
End-to-end encryption can be used to protect speech, circuit-mode data, SDS messages, and packet data.
Why does ETSI not specify the detailed implementation of end-to-end security?
ETSI does not specify the details of end-to-end security because the details tend to be user-specific.
What components comprise TETRA air interface security?
TETRA air interface security comprises air-interface encryption, authentication, key management, and enable/disable.
What are the two main purposes of authentication in TETRA systems?

Authentication allows the SwMI to test the authenticity of the user to protect against misuse by unauthorized users, and it provides the MS with a means to test the validity of the present BS to avoid using a fake BS that could disrupt or intercept communications.
How does Over-The-Air Rekeying (OTAR) enhance TETRA system security?
OTAR enhances overall security by providing secure mechanisms for updating encryption keys, making it easy for the SwMI's security manager to update the encryption keys in the MSs.
Which components are included in the MS’s TETRA protocol stack for air-interface security functions?
The components include signalling and traffic functions, air interface encryption, and channel coding, scrambling, interleaving and slot stealing.
What are the key characteristics of Class 2 air-interface encryption regarding key usage and broadcast signalling?

Class 2 air-interface encryption uses a Static Cipher Key (SCK) that is common to all Mobile Stations (MSs) using encryption on the same SwMI. Additionally, some broadcast signalling is not encrypted in this class.
How are cipher keys managed for group-addressed downlink signalling in Class 3?

Which TETRA encryption algorithms are restricted for use by public safety users in Schengen and related European countries?
TEA2 and TEA5 are intended for use by public safety users in Schengen and related European countries only.
How does the TETRA encryption mechanism process plain text bits?
Each bit of plain text is bit-wise exclusive ORed (XORed) with a pseudo-random key stream emitted by a Key Stream Generator (KSG).
Why does TETRA use a stream cipher for air-interface security?

TETRA uses a stream cipher because its simple XOR combining method does not create additional errors in the deciphered plaintext when errors occur in the received cipher text. This prevents noticeable degradation in received speech quality.
How is Encrypted Short Identity (ESI) generated for TEA set A?
For TEA set A, Encrypted Short Identity (ESI) is generated by the use of TA61 identity encryption.
How are KSS bits handled for PDU bits that do not require encryption versus those that do in the fixed-mapping scheme?
Where a PDU bit does not require encryption, the corresponding KSS bit is discarded. Where a PDU bit requires encryption, the corresponding KSS bit is Xored with the PDU bit.
How is a KSS bit processed when the corresponding PDU bit does not require encryption?
The corresponding KSS bit is discarded.
What operation is performed on a KSS bit when the corresponding PDU bit requires encryption?
The corresponding KSS bit is XORed with the PDU bit.
Which authentication algorithm sets may be used when TEA set B is in use?

Why do the TETRA standards not specify detailed methods of end-to-end encryption?
The TETRA standards do not specify detailed methods of end-to-end encryption because the algorithms and methods tend to be user-specific.
